# Proverbs 22 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 22:7 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | [The]-rich over-[the]-poor rules, and-[the]-borrower [is]-servant to-[the]-man [who]-lends. |
| LOGOS | The rich rules over the poor, and the borrower is the slave of the lender. |
| PNEUMA | The rich rule over the poor, and anyone who borrows becomes a servant to the lender. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 22:9 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Good-of eye — he will-be-blessed, for he-gives of-his-bread to-[the]-poor. |
| LOGOS | Whoever has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his bread with the poor. |
| PNEUMA | Generous people will be blessed, because they share what they have with those in need. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 22:10 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |

| EMET | Drive-out a-scoffer and-strife will-go-out, and-quarreling and-dishonor will-cease. |
| LOGOS | Drive out a scoffer, and strife will go out, and quarreling and abuse will cease. |
| PNEUMA | Get rid of the mocker and the fighting stops — the quarreling and insults disappear with them. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| EMET | One-oppressing [the]-poor to-increase for-himself, one-giving to-[the]-rich — only to-lack. |
| LOGOS | Whoever oppresses the poor to increase his own wealth, or gives to the rich, will only come to poverty. |
| PNEUMA | Taking advantage of the poor to get richer, or giving gifts to the wealthy — both lead to poverty. |
